Multi-LLM Council Architecture – Build a Multi-LLM Council: Claude, ChatGPT & Gemini Working Together

Why rely on a single model when you can convene a council? In this architecture, Claude drafts the code, ChatGPT critiques logic bugs, and Gemini fact-checks citations, producing near-zero hallucination rates.

Designed for developers and engineering teams, Multi-LLM Council Architecture accelerates implementation, eliminates repetitive development friction, and streamlines day-to-day coding workflows.

Key Features:
• Set up an orchestration script connecting to your favorite LLM APIs.
• Configure the sequential debate protocol defined in the repository.
• Enjoy thoroughly stress-tested code and zero obvious oversights.
• Multi-pass code verification transcript showing security fixes introduced during debate.
